idea: A cloth-bound book of moon drawings opens on a desk, its pages start to flip on their own and the crescent grows to a full moon, and the last page turns to a line of Su Shi about the moon.
leave: The moon waxes and wanes, and a flip book can hold a whole month of it.
subject: the moon on the pages, from thin crescent to full

device.what: a hand-drawn flip book, one moon phase per page, turned twice a beat
device.why: a month of moon phases is a slow change that a riffled book shows in a few seconds

change.from: a closed blue cloth book on a desk, stamped in gold with a crescent and 月相 手翻书
change.to: the cover open to the left on a patterned endpaper, the first page showing a mostly dark moon

change.from: the open book seen whole on the desk
change.to: the right-hand page filling the frame: a thin lit edge on a dark moon, labelled 初二

change.from: the 初二 crescent on a still page
change.to: pages flipped twice a beat until the full moon of 十五 fills the page

change.from: the 十五 full moon page as one last slow turn begins
change.to: a small moon above 月有阴晴圆缺 and 苏轼《水调歌头》
